def run(data, out):
    idx = 0
    maxLen = 0
    pairs = 0
    insideParenthesis = False
    while idx < len(data):
        if data[idx] == '(':
            insideParenthesis = True
        elif data[idx] == ')':
            insideParenthesis = False
        elif data[idx].isalpha():
            idx -= 1
        if insideParenthesis:
            idx += 1
            while idx != len(data) and data[idx] != ')' and not data[idx].isalpha():
                idx += 1
            if idx == len(data) or not data[idx].isalpha():
                continue
            while idx + 1 < len(data) and data[idx + 1].isalpha():
                idx += 1
            pairs += 1
        else:
            idx += 1
            while idx != len(data) and data[idx] != '(' and not data[idx].isalpha():
                idx += 1
            if idx == len(data) or not data[idx].isalpha():
                continue
            startIdx = idx
            while idx + 1 < len(data) and data[idx + 1].isalpha():
                idx += 1
            maxLen = max(maxLen, idx - startIdx + 1)
    out.write(str(maxLen) + " " + str(pairs) + "\n")

def main():
    import sys
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # Skip the first line as in original code
    # The second line contains the data
    data_line = input_lines[1]
    run(list(data_line), sys.stdout)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
